verses.exactText: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.exactText: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

verses.exactText: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

verses.exactText: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

verses.exactText: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:

verses.exactText: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

verses.exactText: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,

verses.exactText: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

verses.exactText: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

verses.exactText: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.exactText: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

verses.exactText: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

verses.exactText: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:

verses.exactText: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.

verses.exactText: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

verses.exactText: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.exactText: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

verses.exactText: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.exactText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

verses.exactText: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

verses.exactText: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.

verses.exactText: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

verses.exactText: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

verses.exactText: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

verses.exactText: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

verses.exactText: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

verses.exactText: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

verses.exactText: a time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

verses.exactText: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

verses.exactText: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?

verses.exactText: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.

verses.exactText: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.

verses.exactText: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.

verses.exactText: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

verses.exactText: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor anything taken from it; and God hath done it, that men should fear before him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor anything taken from it; and God hath done it, that men should fear before him.

verses.exactText: That which is hath been long ago; and that which is to be hath long ago been: and God seeketh again that which is passed away.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: That which is hath been long ago; and that which is to be hath long ago been: and God seeketh again that which is passed away.

verses.exactText: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

verses.exactText: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

verses.exactText: I said in my heart, It is because of the sons of men, that God may prove them, and that they may see that they themselves are but as beasts.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart, It is because of the sons of men, that God may prove them, and that they may see that they themselves are but as beasts.

verses.exactText: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; and man hath no preeminence above the beasts: for all is vanity.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; and man hath no preeminence above the beasts: for all is vanity.

verses.exactText: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

verses.exactText: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?

verses.exactText: Wherefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him back to see what shall be after him?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Wherefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him back to see what shall be after him?

verses.exactText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.exactText: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The same was in the beginning with God.

verses.exactText: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.

verses.exactText: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

verses.exactText: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.

verses.exactText: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

verses.exactText: The same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.

verses.exactText: He was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.

verses.exactText: There was the true light, even the light which lighteth every man, coming into the world.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There was the true light, even the light which lighteth every man, coming into the world.

verses.exactText: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.

verses.exactText: He came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.

verses.exactText: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:

verses.exactText: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

verses.exactText: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.

verses.exactText: John beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.

verses.exactText: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.

verses.exactText: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

verses.exactText: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

verses.exactText: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?

verses.exactText: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.

verses.exactText: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.

verses.exactText: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

verses.exactText: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

verses.exactText: And they had been sent from the Pharisees.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And they had been sent from the Pharisees.

verses.exactText: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the Christ, neither Elijah, neither the prophet?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the Christ, neither Elijah, neither the prophet?

verses.exactText: John answered them, saying, I baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John answered them, saying, I baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,

verses.exactText: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.

verses.exactText: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.exactText: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!

verses.exactText: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.

verses.exactText: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.

verses.exactText: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.

verses.exactText: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.

verses.exactText: And I have seen, and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And I have seen, and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.

verses.exactText: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;

verses.exactText: and he looked upon Jesus as he walked, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and he looked upon Jesus as he walked, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God!

verses.exactText: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

verses.exactText: And Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?

verses.exactText: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.

verses.exactText: One of the two that heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: One of the two that heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.exactText: He findeth first his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He findeth first his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

verses.exactText: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).

verses.exactText: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.

verses.exactText: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.exactText: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

verses.exactText: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

verses.exactText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

verses.exactText: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

verses.exactText: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.

verses.exactText: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

verses.exactText: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
